sections.title: The letter vê
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (vê) /ve/. It makes one main sound, which you hear in (verde) /ˈveɾ.dɨ/, meaning green. This letter has only one sound in all words. It is always reliable and easy to recognise.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Place your upper teeth lightly against your lower lip. Push air out through the small gap between them. Turn your voice on at the exact same time. This sound is voiced, which means the voice is on. Touch your throat with your hand and feel it buzz while you make the sound.

sections.title: When it appears
paragraphs: The letter (vê) /ve/ always has the same sound in all positions. You hear it at the start of words like (verde) /ˈveɾ.dɨ/. You also hear it in words like (vida) /ˈvi.dɐ/. Its pronunciation never changes before any letter.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: This sound is just like the sound of v in English vine. Some speakers replace it with a sound like b in boat. Do not close both lips together when you speak. Always keep your top teeth on your bottom lip to make the buzz.
